identification: Fifteen 1:43 diecast vintage tractor partwork models: 13 in clear plastic domes on green plinth bases (the Hachette/Universal Hobbies 'Tractors' partwork display style; many orange Italian/French marques such as Landini, OM, SAME, Renault, Someca, Vierzon, plus a blue Fordson-type, red Porsche/Hurlimann-type, green Deutz/John Deere-type and grey Ferguson-type), and 2 loose models on black plinths (a grey/black early tractor with red spoked wheels, Lanz/Hanomag type, and a grey Porsche/Lanz Bulldog-type). No boxes or magazines.
